Your modeled journey

Contribution here is gross profit minus media spend. It excludes additional acquisition costs, fixed overhead, tax, and timing effects. Media-only CAC differs from fully loaded CAC. Break-even ROAS depends on the pre-media margin.

Calculated measures

A zero denominator produces “Undefined.” Simplified revenue LTV = monthly ARPA ÷ monthly churn; it excludes gross margin and assumes stable churn and revenue.
